selection: 48 ETKDG candidates per isolated fragment; converged MMFF94s; 10 kcal/mol window; lowest-energy seed plus heavy-atom diversity; three host/guest/pose combinations; same starting coordinates in both environments
interpretation: Local single-PFAS counterion exchange; counterion fractions unknown; no bulk capacity or transport prediction
queue_order: Within each resource group: all salt/ion references and PFBA/PFOA/PFNA first, water then unsolvated; PFOS next, water then unsolvated; PFPeA/PFHpA last, water then unsolvated. Within each block/environment, references precede complexes. Workers atomically claim the next job. Resource groups advance independently; completion order is not guaranteed.
method_checks: 32 aqueous M06-2X single points: A400 PFBA/PFOS and Cl/F references; PC4P PFBA and Cl references; PC4P-Me PFBA at both sites with retained I and ClI/II references; both free PFBA/PFOS conformers and free Cl/I/F.
